free_tier.stated: No account, no quota. "Free forever. Zero sign-up. Push any OCI artifact with a TTL." Storage is bounded only by the TTL, max advertised 24 hours.

egress.terms: Unmetered and anonymous: blobs are 307-redirected to a presigned S3 URL (s3.us-east-1.storage.sh, X-Amz-Expires=1200), so bytes come off object storage, not the registry host. Range requests work.

tooling: Any distribution-spec client: oras, docker, skopeo, crane, regctl. Built on zot (per the repo: 'Zot runs an off-the-shelf image ghcr.io/project-zot/zot-linux-amd64 ... points zot at an S3-compatible bucket').
chaining: Unlimited anonymous identities x unlimited repos x unlimited blobs. Because there is no account at all, repo names are the only namespace; rate-limiting is per-IP only, so N egress IPs = N x throughput. Effectively an unlimited free write/read buffer that garbage-collects itself.
limits_note: TTL max 24h advertised (:5m/:1h/:6h/:24h), default 1h. Upload is slow (~11 MB/s observed: 1.5GB in 2m11s), so throughput is the practical per-connection cap. _catalog is blocked by nginx (401), tags/list is open.

identity_cost.detail: derived from the record's prose, not from an identity field, and no signup was executed: No account, no quota. "Free forever. Zero sign-up. Push any OCI artifact with a TTL." Storage is bounded only by the TTL, max adve

reliability_note: Expiry is best-effort: the deployment repo states 'Tag expiry is handled separately and is not yet wired up in this repo', and open issue #151 reports images not expiring. Data WILL vanish at TTL; do not treat as durable. Intermittent connect timeouts observed from this network.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.

evidence.proved: read live: 'Free forever. Zero sign-up. Push any OCI artifact with a TTL. No auth, no config, no account.'; 'Choose your TTL. Default is 1 hour, max is 24 hours.'
probe: POST -> 202 Accepted with Location header, no credentials of any kind

probe: PATCH .../blobs/uploads/<uuid> with 256MiB random -> 202, Range: 0-1048575; then PUT ?digest=sha256:... -> 201 Created; PUT /v2/probe4941/manifests/24h -> 201; GET /v2/probe4941/manifests/24h -> 200 returning the exact manifest
probe: 1.5GB anonymous upload -> HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted, Range: 0-1499999999, then commit PUT -> 201 Created, digest sha256:1c5954e1c91f... (no 413, no chunking needed)
probe: GET blob -> 307 to (presigned, CF/S3-edge served); ranged GET -r 0-1048575 -> 206, 1048576 bytes
read live: 'Tag expiry is handled separately and is not yet wired up in this repo'; zot-config.json.j2 confirms S3 driver, dedupe:false, retention delay 1h with deleteUntagged
